description: SP ENW - DFES - Lake District Data is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - DFES - Lake District Data - New 2026 Release The Lake District Data section within our Distributed Future Electricity Scenarios (DFES) content, details our view of the North West’s future electricity requirements and represents forecasts based on the network infrastructure within the Lake District National Park The collection ... Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Forecasting Data. Its keywords are DFES, Lake District, Lakeland, DFESMAP, Battery Storage Persona, Distributed Generator Persona. The portal shows 2026-05-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
